issues.description: The problem statement / UML specifies the Animal attribute 'name' as type String, but the solution implementation uses a private field of type StringBuilder for the same attribute. This is a structural mismatch in the declared attribute type and may confuse students or cause reflection-based tests that expect a String field to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Animal.name field use type String to match the UML and problem description (e.g., private String name; with corresponding getter/setter), or update the problem statement/UML to explicitly allow an implementation detail such as StringBuilder. Prefer making the field a String to avoid confusing students and to match the specified design.
